args.command:
grep -q '^.next' .gitignore && git add app next.config.ts tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts package.json package-lock.json && git commit -m "Migrate to Cache Components

Replace experimental.dynamicIO with the stable cacheComponents flag.
The newsroom feed keeps its hourly policy via 'use cache' +
cacheLife('hours') instead of segment-level revalidate, and the editor
preview stays request-specific by reading cookies() inside a Suspense
boundary instead of force-dynamic, so no route is opted out of
prerendering.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git status --short
